page.overview:
What is Dawn Island?

Dawn Island is an island located in the East Blue and where the Goa Kingdom is situated. It is the home island of Monkey D. Luffy and the starting point of his journey into piracy, as well as the home island of his father, Monkey D. Dragon and grandfather, Monkey D. Garp. This is also the adopted home of Portgas D. Ace after the death of his mother and the home of Sabo and his family.

Goa Kingdom stretches across the entire island, which consists mostly of rural farmland (with at least one village). The capital is a huge, sprawling city surrounded by a chain of low, forested mountains that are home for several groups of bandits. It is unknown how many villages there are or how many people live here.

Seventy-eight years ago, Monkey D. Garp was born on this island.

Fifty-five years ago, Garp fathered and raised his son, Dragon on this island.
